overview: This single-page Department of State list of papers records a Navy Department item concerning Japanese news-gathering activity in the Soviet Union. The indexed paper, dated November 20, 1942, concerned the return of Japanese correspondents to Moscow and quoted a message from the U.S. Naval Attaché there; it was cross-filed or noted to decimal file 701.9461.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: News-Gathering Agencies of Japan in Russia
subfiles.about: This filing list indexes a Navy Department paper about the return of Japanese correspondents to Moscow.
subfiles.summary: The Department of State list identifies a Navy Department paper dated November 20, 1942. That paper quoted a message from the Naval Attaché in Moscow concerning the return of Japanese correspondents to the city. The entry was noted to decimal file 701.9461.

interest: The page is useful as archival evidence for a potentially missing or separately filed wartime Navy Department communication about Japanese correspondents in Moscow. Its notation to decimal file 701.9461 provides a valuable cross-reference for reconstructing the documentary trail and studying official monitoring of Japanese news-gathering activity in the Soviet Union during the Second World War.
